relationships.subject: R-954
relationships.evidence_quote: The administration of R-954 or progesterone, for 15 consecutive days, prevented the progression of cyst development, reduced the size and weight of the cysts.

key_findings: B1 receptor antagonist R-954 reduced cyst size, inflammatory mediators (IL-1beta, IL-6, TNF) and VEGF in a murine endometriosis model without disturbing the estrous cycle.
